# Diego Orrego

> Engineer, entrepreneur and product builder based in Concepción, Chile. This portfolio connects product creation, software, organizational wellbeing and applied research.

The website is English-first, with Spanish available through its language controls. The profile below is the public Markdown companion to the website. Research estimates describe associations with emotional exhaustion, a dimension of burnout; they do not demonstrate causal effects. Inpla's role ended in January 2026.

## Profile

- [Public profile and project notes](https://diorrego.github.io/diorrego/profile.md): Career timeline, product work, skills and structural equation modeling results.
- [Interactive portfolio](https://diorrego.github.io/diorrego/): Bilingual project cases, research and contact information.

## Products

- [woku](https://woku.app/): Customer experience product; Diego is founder and CTO of its current stage.
- [Inpla](https://inpla.ai/): Conversational business intelligence; Diego's cofounder role ended in January 2026.
- [Veily](https://veily.dev/): Privacy in AI workflows.
- [Wondeya](https://wondeya.com/): Product experiences and experimentation.
- [Muveya](https://muveya.com/): Product exploration.

## Research

- [Workplace wellbeing research, Universidad de Concepción, 2018](https://repositorio.udec.cl/server/api/core/bitstreams/44fc5fab-5b09-49b1-b5a6-4e13c93eaa0d/content): Original Spanish PDF; SEM models of PERMA components and emotional exhaustion, with 174 respondents.
